character: Extreme-contrast street circuit — a super-narrow castle section through Baku's old town followed by the longest straight on the calendar. Demands precision at low speed and bravery at over 300 km/h.
sources: https://www.formula1.com/en/racing/2026/azerbaijan/circuit official F1 circuit guide; Castle Section naming well documented

corners.name: Turn 1-3
corners.technique: Firm braking from the start/finish straight, precise through the direction changes
corners.trap: Over-driving the entry and compromising the run through T2-T3

corners.name: Castle Section
corners.type: extremely narrow, low-speed section by the old city walls
corners.technique: Precision over speed — the track narrows dramatically, patient and exact placement
corners.trap: Any misjudgement here risks wall contact on both sides

corners.name: Turn 8
corners.type: tight corner exiting the castle section
corners.technique: Prioritise a clean exit — feeds the run back to the long back straight
corners.trap: Poor exit here costs time all the way down the straight

corners.name: Turn 15-16
corners.type: final chicane before the pit straight
corners.technique: Late, hard braking from very high speed, precise through the chicane
corners.trap: Braking too late from the highest straight-line speed on the calendar
